title: Strain catalog
name: Strain name
metadataHelp: For THC and CBD, copy the source’s values or ranges. Leave unknown details blank.
archiveHelp: Archived strains remain available and can be restored.
overrideHelp: Choose days or weeks for each duration. Leave blank to use the default; set flush to 0 to disable it.
globalHelp: Default durations apply unless a strain has its own values. Choose days or weeks; changing units keeps the same duration. These settings do not advance plants or control hardware.

errors.conflict: This record has changed. Reload the catalog and review the current values before saving again.
errors.nameTaken: A strain already uses this name, including archived strains.
errors.inUse: This strain is used by plants. Archive it or delete those plants first.

validation.invalid: Check the form fields and try again.
validation.duration: Use a duration equivalent to whole days, within 1–3650 days (0–3650 for flush).
validation.workflow: Check stage names, action destinations, identifiers and flush settings. Every stage needs a path to archive.
validation.stageInUse: Move plants out of this stage before removing it.
validation.name: Enter a name between 1 and 120 characters.
validation.url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL, or leave it empty.
validation.yield: Enter a yield from 0 to 99,999,999.99 g/m², with at most two decimal places.
validation.classification: Choose indica, sativa or hybrid, or leave it unspecified.
validation.stock: Choose an available seed stock counted in units and not already linked to another strain.
validation.stageName: Enter a stage or action name of at most 80 characters. Custom stages and actions need a name.
validation.flush: Flush requires a fixed duration and watering enabled.
validation.wateringDays: Use a whole number between 1 and 3,650 days.
validation.moisture: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with at most two decimal places.
validation.targetLocation: Choose an available location you can access.

stockHelp: Choose a Seeds item. Manage quantities in Inventory; linking does not change stock.
wateringHelp: A recent soil moisture reading takes priority. Without one, use the watering delay set for the location.

workflow.scheduleHelp: New durations apply to new plants and added stages. Existing due dates stay unchanged. A stage in use cannot be removed. Awaiting sowing and Archived remain the start and end. Weeks advance automatically; actions confirm stage changes.
workflow.name: Name
workflow.flush: Apply the flush period at the end of this stage
workflow.actionHelp: Choose the next stage, including an earlier one, or stay here to record care without changing dates. Each stage needs a path to archive. Actions can include comments and attachments.
workflow.automaticRelocationHelp: Move plants to their configured destination when entering a stage. Destinations may be in another site. Without a destination, keep the current location.
workflow.relocationHelp: Used on stage entry only when automatic movement is enabled. An unavailable or inaccessible destination blocks the action.
workflow.locationUnavailable: Destination unavailable. Choose another location or clear it before enabling automatic movement.

deleteHelp: The strain will be permanently deleted. Deletion is blocked while any plants use this strain. Files and stock will be kept.
